title: UiKit prop deprecation
description: One deprecated prop: when it was deprecated, the prop that replaces it, and what a caller has to do differently. All three are required - a deprecation without a replacement leaves the caller with no next move, which is the same failure a "don't" without an alternative has.

replacement.description: Name of a prop declared by the component, not a type id. Checked against the extracted prop list by the conformance test.
